title: Usage measurement truth
description: Objective: normalize provider-neutral usage evidence without laundering incomplete metering. Deliverable: packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-measurement.ts, its one-line .js bridge, and focused tests for COMPLETE, PARTIAL, and UNKNOWN coverage; exact measurement-source provenance; monotonic event-id/sequence handling; immutable pricebook binding for derived list price; and a structurally PolicyFactInput-compatible budget fact. NOT in scope: provider parsing, billing APIs, quotes as spend, account mutation, reservation settlement, policy evaluation, persistence, or package-root export. Hard dependency: task-7dc2e4870d7d4096a1be7b5991e50e94 must be DONE unchanged; design against the committed PolicyFactInput shape {factId,tier,truthClass} without importing @moe/core. Owned paths: budget-measurement.ts, budget-measurement.js, budget-measurement.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-measurement.test.ts.
definitionOfDone: Accepted measurements retain meter, integer quantity when known, COMPLETE|PARTIAL|UNKNOWN coverage, exact source, provider run ID, source/parser version, sequence, raw receipt digest, and observed interval in a deeply frozen detached record.

UNKNOWN requires a null quantity and projects an UNKNOWN required budget fact; it is never normalized to zero, ALLOW, COMPLETE, or an actual-cost claim. PARTIAL retains its exact lower bound and remains unresolved.
Only the six pinned measurement sources are accepted; derived list-price measurements require an immutable pricebook revision and cannot claim ACTUAL_BILLED.

Duplicate same-identity same-bytes observations are deterministic no-ops, while gaps, counter regression, same identity with different bytes, malformed provenance, truncation, and unknown schema versions fail closed or remain UNKNOWN under frozen deterministic issues.
Both TypeScript files are <=250 physical lines, the bridge is one exact re-export line, and the focused verification command exits 0.
taskRails: Do not import @moe/core/@moe/contracts or duplicate policy evaluation; emit only the committed PolicyFactInput-compatible fact for a future composition boundary.
No floating point, guessed cost, quote commitment, discount/credit/tax inference, or uncorrelated billing claim.
Production and test TypeScript files must each be <=250 physical lines; stage only the three explicit owned paths.

repeat over equal bytes deep-equal; (2) UNKNOWN DISCIPLINE: coverage UNKNOWN requires quantity null (nonnull -> refuse, exact code) and PROJECTS a required budget fact { factId: deterministic from meter+providerRunRef+sequence, tier: null, truthClass: 'UNKNOWN' } — never zero, never COMPLETE, never an actual-cost claim (attempt each laundering path, assert refusal code); source/coverage CONSISTENCY matrix — PROVIDER_REPORTED_COMPLETE requires coverage COMPLETE, PROVIDER_REPORTED_PARTIAL requires PARTIAL, source UNKNOWN requires coverage UNKNOWN (each mismatch -> measurement-layer code); same identity DIFFERENT bytes -> fail closed (exact code — the CORE-I9 analogue); sequence GAP detection -> typed gap issue or UNKNOWN-family outcome (never silent); counter REGRESSION (sequence lower than seen) -> fail closed; truncation/unknown schema version markers -> remain UNKNOWN (never invented completion); (7) hostile inputs via '../runtime-shape.js' helpers (proxy/accessor/extra-key/prototype) -> contract-layer refusals. (2) all nine DoD fields retained, deeply frozen, detached from the caller (mutating the caller's interval and envelope after the call changes nothing), repeat deep-equal. (3) UNKNOWN: quantity null, fact {tier:null, truthClass:"UNKNOWN"}; laundering refused — quantity 0/1200 -> CONTRACT:BUDGET_MEASUREMENT_COVERAGE_QUANTITY_MISMATCH, source upgrade to PROVIDER_REPORTED_COMPLETE/ACTUAL_BILLED/DERIVED_LIST_PRICE and coverage upgrade to COMPLETE -> MEASUREMENT:_SOURCE_COVERAGE_MISMATCH. (4) PARTIAL keeps its exact lower bound (0 and 5 both). (5) 6x3 source/coverage sweep with a non-vacuity assertion on its own case counts: expect([accepts, refusals]).toStrictEqual([9, 9]). (6) DERIVED_LIST_PRICE requires an immutable binding {pricebookRevisionRef, unitPriceMicros, pricedAtRef} — 8 malformed variants incl. fractional and negative micros -> _PRICEBOOK_BINDING_INVALID; ACTUAL_BILLED/PROVIDER_REPORTED_COMPLETE/SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTA carrying a binding -> _UNCORRELATED_BILLING_CLAIM; derived fact truthClass UNKNOWN and factId carries the DERIVED_LIST_PRICE marker. (7) monotonic identity vs a caller-supplied prior: same-bytes duplicate returns the prior object by reference (toBe), different bytes (digest, quantity, or truncated flag) -> _IDENTITY_CONFLICT, sequence 10 after 7 -> _SEQUENCE_GAP, sequence 6/0 or a different meter at the same sequence -> _SEQUENCE_REGRESSION, foreign providerRunRef prior -> _STREAM_MISMATCH. (8) truncated + COMPLETE -> _TRUNCATED_COMPLETION_CLAIM (PARTIAL/UNKNOWN pass); sourceParserVersion 9 with COMPLETE/PARTIAL -> _PARSER_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, with UNKNOWN coverage it stays accepted as UNKNOWN. Mutation checklist naming each pinned production check is in the file header.

Shape: normalizeUsageMeasurement(input, prior?) -> MeasurementResult<NormalizedMeasurement>. readObservation guards the {measurement, pricebookBinding, truncated} envelope via runtime-shape helpers, then validateUsageMeasurement (contract layer) runs and SHORT-CIRCUITS with its issues re-tagged {layer:"CONTRACT"} — truth rules never judge an unvalidated record. checkStandalone applies source/coverage (SOURCE_COVERAGES table), pricebook binding, truncation, and parser-version rules; checkAgainstPrior applies stream/identity/sequence rules against the caller's snapshot. Issues are sorted deterministically before failing.

Deviation from the plan text, deliberate and noted in step-1: measurement-layer codes use the BUDGET_OBSERVATION_ prefix, not BUDGET_MEASUREMENT_, because the contract layer already owns BUDGET_MEASUREMENT_MALFORMED/_FIELD_INVALID/_COVERAGE_QUANTITY_MISMATCH and reuse would make which-layer-refused unassertable. Each issue additionally carries an explicit `layer` discriminant, so the two-layer assertion is structural rather than a prefix convention; a test proves MEASUREMENT_ISSUE_CODES is disjoint from BUDGET_ISSUE_CODES.

Truth-class derivation (from source honesty, never caller-asserted): ACTUAL_BILLED -> OBSERVED; PROVIDER_REPORTED_COMPLETE/PROVIDER_REPORTED_PARTIAL/SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTA -> AGENT_REPORTED; DERIVED_LIST_PRICE -> UNKNOWN (an estimate is not an observation, design 638-653); UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN. Derived is kept distinguishable from genuinely-unknown by the factId, which spells the source: `budget.usage:<SOURCE>:<providerRunRef>|<meter>|<sequence>`. tier is always null (MEASUREMENT_FACT_TIER) — a usage measurement bears no risk tier. Fact is frozen with exactly three keys.

Purity: no module-level registry, so identical arguments always give an identical answer; no Date, no Math.random, no floating point; only in-package './budget-contract.js' and '../runtime-shape.js' imports. Duplicate same-identity same-bytes returns the caller's prior object by reference (toBe), gated on zero issues.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Direct plan, no verification workflow: the governor's task card is written at full fidelity against the LANDED sibling surface (verified on-screen: six sources, coverages, validateUsageMeasurement, UsageMeasurementRecord fields exactly matching the DoD's nine), the PolicyFactInput mirror shape is committed and read, and every convention (in-package '.js' imports, runtime-shape reuse, clone-set, bridge, unexported subdir, per-file 250) is established across four sibling plans. Design choices: (1) PURE monotonicity — caller supplies the prior-observation snapshot; an internal registry would make the module stateful and nondeterministic (kernel purity precedent); (2) two-layer issue codes — contract layer (landed BUDGET_*) vs measurement layer (new BUDGET_MEASUREMENT_*) so tests can assert WHICH layer refused (the new epic rail demands it); (3) truthClass derivation from source honesty rather than caller assertion — a caller-supplied truth class on a measurement would be self-attestation; (4) DERIVED_LIST_PRICE pricebook binding as required sub-record with integer micros — no float, no billing claim (design 638-653: derived list price never becomes actual cost; ACTUAL_BILLED only with a correlated receipt); (5) duplicate-same-bytes as deterministic NO-OP returning the prior record — idempotent evidence ingestion (CORE-I9 analogue: same identity + different bytes is a hard conflict).
